title: Find the margin in your payment stack
description: A fixed-scope Margin Teardown: where your payment cost goes, and the three moves that win it back.
lede: Bring us one payment cost number. In two weeks you get the teardown, the evidence and a short list of moves your team can run.
steps: Share the cost line that keeps you up at night.
Scheme, acquirer, processor: every hop, priced.
Each move ranked by size of win and effort to run.
A one-page plan your team can start on Monday.
proof: Terrain, not relationships. Every claim is sourced to a public rule or your own data.
